description: This file defines menu-related functions and components for an Electron-based desktop application, including context menus, application menus, update handling, and platform-specific menu configurations.

methods.name: buildContextMenu
methods.description: Creates a context menu for the web contents, including spellcheck suggestions and standard editing options.

methods.name: suggestionsMenu
methods.description: Generates menu items for spellcheck suggestions and learn spelling option.

methods.name: createMenuManager
methods.description: Builds and manages the application menu, including platform-specific configurations and update options.

methods.name: macAppMenu
methods.description: Constructs the application menu for macOS.

methods.name: editMenu
methods.description: Constructs the edit menu, including spellchecker languages and speech options.

methods.name: macSpeechMenu
methods.description: Creates speech-related menu items for macOS.

methods.name: spellcheckerMenu
methods.description: Builds the spellchecker language selection submenu.

methods.name: viewMenu
methods.description: Constructs the view menu with reload, dev tools, zoom, and full screen options.

methods.name: menuBarOptions
methods.description: Provides options to toggle system menu bar and themed menu bar.

methods.name: windowMenu
methods.description: Creates the window menu with minimize, close, and platform-specific items.

methods.name: macWindowItems
methods.description: Provides window menu items specific to macOS.

methods.name: minimizeToTrayItem
methods.description: Creates a menu item to toggle minimizing the app to tray.

methods.name: updateMenu
methods.description: Constructs the update menu with version and auto-update options.

methods.name: helpMenu
methods.description: Creates the help menu with support links and dev tools toggle.

methods.name: keyringMenu
methods.description: Builds the security menu for keyring options.
